items.title: What is Palisociety? Your guide to one of Marriott’s newest boutique collections
items.why: Marriott is pulling independent boutique hotels into Bonvoy, a loyalty expansion worth tracking for hotel perk partnerships.
items.summary_ai: Palisociety, a California boutique hotel collection with more than 20 U.S. sites, is now partly participating in Marriott Bonvoy.
items.take: Marriott is pulling independent boutique hotels into Bonvoy, a loyalty expansion worth tracking for hotel perk partnerships.
